page_title: Bilinear ergodic Hilbert variation for commuting transformations | Alec Kriebel
meta_description: Bilinear ergodic Hilbert sums for commuting transformations: full pointwise variation and convergence via annular triangular variation and explicit transference.
abstract_text: We give an explicit restriction and transference consequence of OpenAI's October 5, 2026 full annular variation theorem for the triangular Hilbert transform. For arbitrary commuting invertible probability-preserving transformations S,T and complex f,g∈L^3, the symmetric bilinear Hilbert sums have bounded pointwise r-variation in L^(3/2) for every r>2, and converge almost everywhere and in L^(3/2). The restriction uses boxes of fixed positive area and a uniformly summable kernel error. The analytic breakthrough is the cited continuous theorem; the present note supplies the discrete restriction and full measure-theoretic transfer.
